# ragkit.yaml reference

Every key of the project file, generated from `ragkit.core.config`. Strings may reference environment variables as `${VAR}` or `${VAR:-default}`; the project's `.env` is loaded first. Unknown keys are rejected, except under a source.

## Top level

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | Project name; also the default tracing service name. |
| `mode` | `local` \| `cluster` | `"local"` | Informational only; backends are chosen by `store.backend` and each agent's `memory.checkpointer`. |
| `default_model` | string | `"google_genai:gemini-3.5-flash-lite"` | Chat model for agents that do not set `model`, as provider:model. |
| `agents_dir` | string | `"agents"` | Folder that holds agent folders, relative to the project root. |
| `database_url` | string \| null | — | Postgres URL for the postgres store, job queue and checkpointer. |
| `server` | [object](#server) | see below | Defaults for `ragkit serve`. |
| `store` | [object](#store) | see below | Where documents, chunks and embeddings are kept. |
| `embeddings` | [object](#embeddings) | see below | Embedding model for ingestion and search. |
| `rerank` | [object](#rerank) \| null | — | Default reranker for every search, unless a search or agent turns it off or overrides it. |
| `collections` | map of string to [object](#collectionsname) | `{}` | Document collections by name (lowercase letters, digits, - and _). |
| `mcp_servers` | map of string to [object](#mcp_serversname) | `{}` | MCP servers whose tools agents can use, by name. |
| `observability` | [object](#observability) | see below | Tracing export. |
| `pricing` | map of string to [object](#pricingname) | `{}` | Prices by provider:model, used for cost tracking. |
| `evals` | [object](#evals) | see below | Settings for `ragkit eval`. |
| `auth` | [object](#auth) | see below | Authentication for the HTTP API. |
| `queue` | [object](#queue) | see below | Ingestion job queue. |
| `cache` | [object](#cache) | see below | In-process caches. |

## `server`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string | `"127.0.0.1"` | Address `ragkit serve` binds to. |
| `port` | integer | `8000` | Port `ragkit serve` listens on. |
| `cors_origins` | list of string | `[]` | Browser origins allowed to call the API. |

## `store`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `sqlite` \| `postgres` | `"sqlite"` | `sqlite` keeps everything in one local file; `postgres` uses `database_url` with pgvector. |
| `path` | string | `".ragkit/index.db"` | SQLite file, relative to the project root. |

## `embeddings`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | `"google_genai:gemini-embedding-2"` | provider:model |
| `dimensions` | integer \| null | `768` | Output size for models that support shortening. |
| `batch_size` | integer | `64` | Texts per embedding request during ingestion. |

## `rerank`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | **required** | Reranker plugin: cohere, voyage or cross-encoder. |
| `model` | string \| null | — | Model name; each provider has a default. |
| `top_n` | integer | `8` | Results kept after reranking when a search does not ask for a number. |

## `collections.<name>`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | `""` | Shown to agents deciding what to search, and in listings. |
| `sources` | list of [object](#collectionsnamesources) | `[]` | Where the documents come from. |
| `parser` | `basic` \| `docling` | `"basic"` | `docling` uses layout-aware conversion for PDF and office files (needs `ragkit- ingest[docling]`). |
| `chunking` | [object](#collectionsnamechunking) | see below | How documents are split into chunks. |
| `acl` | list of string | `[]` | Principals allowed to read; empty means everyone. |
| `tenant` | string | `"default"` | Tenant that owns the documents. |
| `shared` | boolean | `false` | Searchable by every tenant (still subject to acl). |
| `sync_every` | string \| null | — | Re-ingest on this interval when a scheduler runs, e.g. 15m or 6h. |

## `collections.<name>.sources[]`

One data source. Fields besides `type` are validated by the connector.

Other keys are passed to the connector (see *Connector options*).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | **required** | Connector name, or 'module:Class' for a custom one. |

## `collections.<name>.chunking`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_tokens` | integer | `400` | Largest chunk, estimated at four characters per token. |
| `overlap_tokens` | integer | `40` | Words from the end of a chunk repeated at the start of the next one. |

## `mcp_servers.<name>`

An MCP server whose tools agents can use (`tools.mcp` in agent.yaml).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transport` | `stdio` \| `http` \| `sse` \| `websocket` | `"stdio"` | How to reach the server. |
| `command` | string \| null | — | stdio: program to start. |
| `args` | list of string | `[]` | stdio: command arguments. |
| `env` | map of string to string | `{}` | stdio: extra environment variables (PATH and HOME are kept). |
| `cwd` | string \| null | — | stdio: working directory (default: root). |
| `url` | string \| null | — | http, sse, websocket: server URL. |
| `headers` | map of string to string | `{}` | http and sse: request headers, such as Authorization. |
| `timeout` | number | `30` | http and sse: seconds to wait for a response. |

## `observability`

Where traces go. Spans follow the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `exporter` | `none` \| `console` \| `otlp` \| `langfuse` \| `phoenix` | `"none"` | Where spans go; `none` turns tracing off. |
| `endpoint` | string \| null | — | OTLP/HTTP traces URL; defaults depend on the exporter. |
| `headers` | map of string to string | `{}` | Extra headers for OTLP requests. |
| `service_name` | string \| null | — | Defaults to the project name. |
| `capture_content` | boolean | `false` | Record prompts, replies, tool arguments and results on spans. |
| `sample_ratio` | number | `1.0` | Share of traces kept (parent-based). |
| `langfuse` | [object](#observabilitylangfuse) | see below | Langfuse host and key variables, for `exporter: langfuse`. |

## `observability.langfuse`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string | `"https://cloud.langfuse.com"` | Langfuse base URL (the EU cloud by default). |
| `public_key_env` | string | `"LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY"` | Variable holding the Langfuse public key. |
| `secret_key_env` | string | `"LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY"` | Variable holding the Langfuse secret key. |

## `pricing.<name>`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input_per_million` | number | **required** | USD per million input tokens. |
| `output_per_million` | number | **required** | USD per million output tokens. |

## `evals`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `judge_model` | string \| null | — | Model that grades answers; defaults to default_model. |
| `concurrency` | integer | `4` | Eval cases run at the same time. |
| `on_approval` | `approve` \| `reject` | `"reject"` | How evals answer approval requests; reject avoids real side effects. |

## `auth`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `none` \| `api_key` \| `jwt` | `"none"` | `none` (local use), `api_key` or `jwt`. |
| `api_keys` | list of [object](#authapi_keys) | `[]` | Accepted keys, for `mode: api_key`. |

## `auth.api_keys[]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key_env` | string | **required** | Environment variable that holds the key. |
| `name` | string \| null | — | Label used as the user id in traces. |
| `tenant` | string | `"default"` | Tenant the caller acts as. |
| `principals` | list of string | `[]` | Groups matched against document ACLs. |
| `scopes` | list of `chat` \| `search` \| `ingest` \| `admin` | `["chat", "search"]` | Operations the key may perform. |

## `auth.jwt`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jwks_url` | string \| null | — | For RS256/ES256 tokens. |
| `secret_env` | string \| null | — | For HS256 tokens. |
| `algorithms` | list of string | `["RS256"]` | Accepted signing algorithms. |
| `issuer` | string \| null | — | Required `iss` claim, if set. |

| `tenant_claim` | string | `"tenant"` | Claim holding the tenant. |

| `scopes_claim` | string | `"scope"` | Claim holding scopes (space-separated or a list). |

## `queue`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lease_seconds` | integer | `300` | A job is retried after this. |
| `max_attempts` | integer | `3` | Tries before a job is marked failed. |
| `poll_seconds` | number | `2.0` | How often an idle worker checks for jobs. |

## `cache`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_embeddings` | integer | `10000` | Query embeddings kept in memory; 0 disables. |
| `search_ttl_seconds` | number | `0` | Reuse identical search results for this long; 0 disables. |
| `search_entries` | integer | `10000` | Most search results kept in memory. |

## Connector options

Keys accepted under `collections.<name>.sources[]` for each built-in `type`.

### `type: files`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string \| null | — | Overrides the connector's default identity. Changing it re-ingests the source. |
| `path` | string | **required** | Directory to read, relative to the project root. |
| `include` | list of string | `["**/*"]` | Globs of files to read; `**` matches any folders. |
| `exclude` | list of string | `[]` | Globs of files to skip. |
| `include_hidden` | boolean | `false` | Also read files and folders whose names start with a dot. |
| `max_file_mb` | number | `50` | Skip files larger than this. |

### `type: web`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string \| null | — | Overrides the connector's default identity. Changing it re-ingests the source. |
| `urls` | list of string | **required** | Start pages. The crawl stays under each one's host and path. |
| `max_pages` | integer | `100` | Most pages fetched per run. |
| `max_depth` | integer | `2` | Link hops from the start pages. |
| `include` | list of string | `[]` | URL globs to keep; empty keeps every in-scope page. |
| `exclude` | list of string | `[]` | URL globs to skip. |
| `respect_robots` | boolean | `true` | Obey robots.txt. |
| `concurrency` | integer | `4` | Pages fetched at once. |
| `timeout` | number | `20` | Seconds per request. |

### `type: github`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string \| null | — | Overrides the connector's default identity. Changing it re-ingests the source. |
| `repo` | string | **required** | owner/name |
| `branch` | string \| null | — | Defaults to the repository's default. |
| `include` | list of string | `["**/*.md", "**/*.mdx", "**/*.rst", "**/*.txt"]` | Globs of files to read. |
| `exclude` | list of string | `[]` | Globs of files to skip. |
| `token_env` | string | `"GITHUB_TOKEN"` | Variable with a GitHub token; optional for public repositories. |
| `max_file_mb` | number | `5` | Skip files larger than this. |
| `concurrency` | integer | `8` | Files downloaded at once. |
| `api_url` | string | `"https://api.github.com"` | GitHub API URL (change for GitHub Enterprise). |
| `raw_url` | string | `"https://raw.githubusercontent.com"` | Host that serves raw file contents. |

### `type: confluence`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string \| null | — | Overrides the connector's default identity. Changing it re-ingests the source. |
| `base_url` | string | **required** | Site URL ending in /wiki, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net/wiki |
| `spaces` | list of string | **required** | Space keys to ingest. |
| `email_env` | string | `"CONFLUENCE_EMAIL"` | Variable with the Atlassian account email; when unset, the token is sent as a bearer token.      |
| `token_env` | string | `"CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN"` | Variable with the API token. |
| `page_size` | integer | `100` | Pages per API request. |

### `type: notion`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string \| null | — | Overrides the connector's default identity. Changing it re-ingests the source. |
| `database_ids` | list of string | `[]` | Databases whose pages to ingest. |
| `page_ids` | list of string | `[]` | Pages to ingest, with the pages beneath them. |
| `include_child_pages` | boolean | `true` | Also ingest pages nested under ingested pages. |
| `token_env` | string | `"NOTION_TOKEN"` | Variable with the integration token. |
| `api_url` | string | `"https://api.notion.com"` | Notion API URL. |
| `notion_version` | string | `"2022-06-28"` | Value of the Notion-Version header. |
| `concurrency` | integer | `3` | Notion allows about 3 requests/s. |
